## Checklist

- [ ] The branch follows the repo convention (`feature/FEAT-XXX-...`, `fix/BUG-XXX-...`, `hotfix/...`, `docs/...`, `chore/...`, `refactor/...`).
- [ ] Commits carry the ID up front (`FEAT-XXX: ...`).
